_comment: Named argument presets for agent.py. Select one with --profile <name> (e.g. --profile xelite-npu). Any field is optional; omitted fields fall back to env vars then built-in defaults. Precedence: explicit CLI flag > profile > env var > default. Naming: <device>-<cpu|npu>. CPU = llama.cpp GGUF server on :8080; NPU = genie_server.py shim over QAIRT/Genie on :8081. The short aliases cpu/npu/iq9 are kept for backward compatibility with the docs.

cpu.description: ALIAS -> local llama.cpp GGUF on CPU (:8080). Generic default.

npu.description: ALIAS -> X Elite Hexagon NPU via Genie (:8081).

iq9.description: ALIAS -> iq9-npu (kept so `--profile iq9` in the docs keeps working).

xelite-cpu.description: X Elite host -- llama.cpp Gemma-4 E4B GGUF on CPU (:8080).

xelite-npu.description: X Elite host -- Qwen3-4B Genie bundle on the Hexagon NPU (HTP v73, :8081).

iq9-cpu.description: IQ9 (QCS9075) -- llama.cpp Gemma-4 12B QAT GGUF on CPU (:8080).

iq9-npu.description: IQ9 (QCS9075) -- Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Genie bundle on the Hexagon NPU (HTP v73; reused X Elite bundle, soc_model patched 60->77) (:8081).

iq9-gemma4-npu.description: IQ9 (QCS9075, HTP v73) -- Gemma-4-E4B-it w4a16 Genie bundle on the Hexagon NPU via genie_server.py (:8081). Native AI Hub qcs9075 bundle (RUNTIME_GENIE, QAIRT 2.45); genie-t2t-run runtime from QAIRT 2.47.1 aarch64-oe-linux. Use --chat-template gemma. Drive from PC via --base-url http://<IQ9_IP>:8081.

iq8-aura-cpu.description: IQ8 QCS8275 using the preinstalled AURA llama.cpp Qwen2.5 0.5B model on CPU (:8080). Use explicit tool instructions for best results.

iq8-cpu.description: IQ8 (~11 GiB RAM) -- llama.cpp Gemma-4 E4B GGUF on CPU (:8080). The tightest-RAM target; E4B is the proven-safe fit.

iq8-npu.description: IQ8 (QCS8275, soc_id 675, HTP v75) NPU -- PENDING: no Genie bundle built yet. NPU verified healthy (qnn-platform-validator DSP Passed) but needs a v75-compiled bundle; the IQ9 v73 soc_model-patch trick does NOT work (arch mismatch). Update model once a v75 bundle is exported and served on :8081.
